metrics: Same 15 case-macro Recall@5 and 90% case-mean gate; every generated eligible target record included; publish missing cases and failed arrivals
confirmation_scope: Small new-family/new-availability check after freezing plans; same OSM, POI catalogue and scenario generator. Not a new city, user population, strong privacy attack, or final thesis confirmation.
no_selection: Do not change plans, seeds, thresholds or reject inconvenient families after observing new scores. Both public category plans and all controls remain in the readout.
cost_modes: query at every existing public event
fixed public plan refreshed at first event of each epoch; identical optimization for fixed K5/K12
private_fields: GPS/route labels belong only to simulator/evaluator/local ranking, never network query policy
